# PhysiX Academy

> Understand Physics. Don't Just Memorize It.

PhysiX Academy is a free, interactive physics learning platform for students of Class 9-12, JEE and NEET. It features hand-written lessons, live in-browser simulations, an offline AI tutor, a formula library, calculators, quizzes and physics games. It is a static site built by R.M.VISANTHAN with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — no framework.

Author: R.M. VISANTHAN (r.m.visanthan@gmail.com)

## Main entry points

- Main site: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/
- Learn (curriculum): https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/learn
- Topics: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/topics
- Simulations: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/sims
- AI Tutor: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/tutor
- Formula library: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/formulas
- Calculators: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/calculators
- Practice/quiz: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/practice
- Games: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/games
- About: https://physix-academy.vercel.app/#/about

## Content notes

- Content is original work by R.M.VISANTHAN, written for educational purposes and inspired by standard textbooks (including NCERT and SL Arora), not verbatim copies.
- The site is a single-page app using hash-based routing (#/route).
- Simulations run entirely in the browser; the "AI tutor" uses offline algorithms over local curriculum data — no external AI API is used.
- Users: students preparing for board exams (Class 9-12), JEE, and NEET.
